- DIRAC is a powerful, robust, scalable and flexible system for managing the production of data and the distribution and management of user analysis data -
the LHCb computing model is ready for real data taking, and that the LHC experiments are ready for real data.
the DIRAC components are ready to support the LHCb data production model and the LHCb computing model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation and evaluation of the data production and management system of the LHCb experiment at CERN.
the development and implementation of the Computing model for the LHCb experiment, and with the preparation of LHCb computing centers for real data taking.
the development of DIRAC as a data management tool and with the implementation of the LHCb data processing model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LHCb DIRAC components are in a very good state, with a very high readiness level, and are ready for the LHCb experiment.
LHCb is prepared for the LHC start-up.
the LHCb computing model is well prepared to support real data taking.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LHCb experiment is ready to take real data.
the LHCb experiment is well prepared to start the data taking with the LHC in November 2009.
the LHCb DIRAC team is fully prepared to support the LHCb experiment in the production of simulated RAW data, and in the processing of these data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LHCb DIRAC system is ready and able to support the LHCb computing model and is prepared to support the LCHb Computing model for data production and analysis.
the LHCb DIRAC system is ready to support real data taking and that all the LHCb computing resources are ready to be used by all LHCb users.
